title: Recover the nested return type inherited through a generic interface
summary: Resolving the interface type now recovers Collection<Optional<String>>. Sibling subclasses preserve distinct Long and String leaves without overrides.

change.description: Resolving a method’s type variable against a concrete class now preserves the arguments of a parameterized binding.

notes: The caller also checks equality with the non-bridge override's reflective Type. The parent returned only the raw Collection.
